title: Weightless Drift
hook: What if you floated in zero‑gravity?
scene: white training chamber with floating tools

beats.label: After ten minutes
beats.line: After ten minutes, blood pools in your head, puffing your face.
beats.idea: Character's face inflates, nose flares, blood streams upward.

beats.label: After twenty-four hours
beats.line: After twenty-four hours, your inner ear can't tell up, causing nausea.
beats.idea: Close‑up of inner ear fluid swirling, character tilting, dizzy expression.

beats.label: By day three
beats.line: By day three, your heart speeds up as leg blood return drops.
beats.idea: Heart animation beats faster, leg veins collapse, chest rises.

beats.label: Six months in
beats.line: Six months in, bones lose roughly one percent density each month.
beats.idea: X‑ray view of thinning bones, character struggling to lift a light object.

description: A paper‑craft cartoon shows how the body reacts to floating in zero‑gravity.

facts.claim: Effect of spaceflight on the human body

topic: What happens if you float in a zero‑gravity simulation?
